|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “Cards with a maintenance cost may not participate in battle on the turn they are deployed, and are placed out of play when they leave the table”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Sergeant Major Bursk (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “[Maintenance] cards may not participate in battle the turn they are deployed and are placed out of play when they leave the table.” '''What changed:''' “Cards with a maintenance cost” → “[Maintenance] cards”; removed “on”; “deployed,” → “deployed”; “table” → “table.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=5 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 5, slip 46. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Sergeant Major Bursk]].
